scenes.title_en: Standing: Push a Shoulder, Look Down
scenes.context: 站姿出片：送肩打破直立感，低头微笑制造不经意氛围。拍照自然松弛。语域：拍照教学，咖啡场景。
sentences: Standing: push a shoulder forward to break the rigid stance.
低头微笑，制造不经意氛围。
Look down with a smile for a casual vibe.
Keep the shot relaxed and natural.
paraphrase: 送肩 → push a shoulder forward / offset the shoulder
push a shoulder · offset the shoulder
不经意氛围 → casual vibe / effortless mood
scenes.speak: Standing: push a shoulder forward to break the rigid stance. Look down with a smile for a casual vibe. Keep the shot relaxed and natural.

scenes.context: 坐姿：交叉腿拉长比例，捂脸笑增加俏皮感。坐拍要注意腿部线条。语域：拍照教学，坐姿技巧。
sentences: Seated: cross the legs to lengthen proportions.
Cover your mouth and laugh for playfulness.
Mind the leg lines when seated.
mind the leg lines（注意腿部线条）
paraphrase: 拉长比例 → lengthen proportions / elongate the frame
俏皮感 → playfulness / a playful touch
scenes.speak: Seated: cross the legs to lengthen proportions. Cover your mouth and laugh for playfulness. Mind the leg lines when seated.

scenes.context: 抬脚叉腰：动态姿势+侧脸，增加不经意的氛围感。动作多一点，画面更生动。语域：拍照教学，动态姿态。
sentences: Foot raised, hand on hip — a dynamic pose.
A profile adds to the mood.
adds to the mood（增加氛围）
动作多一点，画面更生动。
More movement makes the frame livelier.
paraphrase: 叉腰 → hand on hip / hands on hips
hand on hip · hands on hips
侧脸 → profile / a side view
scenes.speak: Foot raised, hand on hip — a dynamic pose. A profile adds to the mood. More movement makes the frame livelier.

scenes.context: 向前一步走：动起来比站着不动更有故事感。最后一步动起来收尾。语域：拍照教学，收尾动作。
sentences: take a step forward（向前一步）
动起来比站着更有故事感。
Moving tells more of a story than standing still.
It's the perfect way to wrap up.
paraphrase: 故事感 → tells a story / a narrative feel
收尾 → wrap up / the closing move
scenes.speak: Take a step forward. Moving tells more of a story than standing still. It's the perfect way to wrap up.

practice: Push a shoulder forward to break the rigid stance.
Cross the legs to lengthen proportions.
Foot raised, hand on hip — a dynamic pose.

pitfalls: Push a shoulder forward to break the rigid stance.
